<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\ReadModels\TransferManagement\Architecture;

use PHPUnit\Framework\TestCase;
use RecursiveDirectoryIterator;
use RecursiveIteratorIterator;
use SplFileInfo;
use Tests\Support\RepositoryPath;

final class TransferManagementOwnershipTest extends TestCase
{
    public function test_management_read_composition_cannot_become_a_domain_writer(): void
    {
        $files = $this->sources('app/ReadModels/TransferManagement');
        self::assertNotEmpty($files);
        foreach ($files as $path => $source) {
            foreach ([' extends Model', '\\Actions\\', '->save(', '->delete(', '->update(', '::create(', '::insert(', '::upsert(', 'DB::statement(', 'DB::insert(', 'DB::update(', 'DB::delete('] as $token) {
                self::assertStringNotContainsString($token, $source, $path.' must remain a read-only composition.');
            }
        }
    }

    public function test_context_owners_do_not_depend_on_the_transfer_management_projection(): void
    {
        foreach ($this->sources('app/Contexts') as $path => $source) {
            self::assertStringNotContainsString('App\\ReadModels\\TransferManagement', $source, $path);
        }
    }

    /** @return array<string,string> */
    private function sources(string $directory): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach (new RecursiveIteratorIterator(new RecursiveDirectoryIterator(RepositoryPath::fromRoot($directory))) as $file) {
            if (! $file instanceof SplFileInfo || ! $file->isFile() || $file->getExtension() !== 'php') {
                continue;
            }
            $source = file_get_contents($file->getPathname());
            self::assertIsString($source, $file->getPathname());
            $result[$file->getPathname()] = $source;
        }

        return $result;
    }
}
